notes.title: Appreciation
notes.content:
Version 2.1.2

Updated to Unreal 5.4

Redesigned all menus

Swapped the "Get Started" button for the "Select" button in the home menu

Alignment and Swapped buttons: "back to menu" for "back" button
- "Options" menu
- "Easter Eggs" menu
- "Options" menu within the "Game Picks" Menu
- "Credits" menu

Swapped the "Start a Battle" button for the "Start" button in the "Choose Your Puppet" menu

Changed the "Battle for the Internet" button to the "Enter the Open World" button in the "Main Menu" menu

Changed the loading screen of the game in all languages

Fixed error when trying to connect in a battle that has not yet been created.	

Changed the "Start" button to the "Battle" button in the "Lobby Menu"

Updated to "Enhanced input action system"

Added English support "United States"

Removed unused files.

Redo Buttons (All Menus)

Added fonts that accept accents

Button alignment in all in-game menus

On Android you can hide the buttons while playing (Fire, Skill...)

Repositioned the buttons on the Host Menu

Added gamepad-controlled mobile button to options menu

Fixed bugs when menu buttons are focused

Adds a confirmation to return to the main menu in the "LobbyMenu"

Removed hide menus in the lobby (Temporarily)

Fixed bug when dragging items from inventories on Android

Fixed error when using (clicking) inventory items on Android

Added animation of appearing and disappearing the chat window

Fixed bug - Now doesn't let you use chat when inventory is open

Initiating the appreciation of the game
